command:
npm install --no-save --no-package-lock playwright@1.56.1 >/dev/null 2>&1
npx playwright install --with-deps chromium >/dev/null 2>&1
python3 -m http.server 8765 --bind 127.0.0.1 >/dev/null 2>&1 &
for _ in $(seq 1 30); do curl -s -o /dev/null http://127.0.0.1:8765/index.html && break; sleep 0.2; done
export OUT=/tmp
node --test tests/web/wiring.mjs 2>&1 | tail -5
fail=0
for t in ultra ultra-board composer-fixes theme activity-state; do
  echo "== $t"
  timeout 300 node tests/web/$t.cjs > /tmp/$t.log 2>&1; code=$?
  grep -E '^(PASS|FAIL)' /tmp/$t.log | cut -c1-260
  grep -E '^errors' /tmp/$t.log | cut -c1-300
  if grep -q '^FAIL' /tmp/$t.log || [ $code -ne 0 ]; then fail=1; echo "exit $code"; tail -5 /tmp/$t.log; fi
done
exit $fail
